features.doc: The position of the finite verb.

levels.name: v1
levels.label: v1
levels.doc: the finite verb is clause-initial, interrogative word order

levels.name: nonV1
levels.label: nonV1
levels.doc: the finite verb is in situ, declarative word order

features.doc: Whether the finite verb is negated.

levels.name: negative
levels.label: negative
levels.doc: a finite verb with the negative prefix

features.doc: The indefinite determiner the experiments manipulate.

levels.name: nci
levels.label: nci
levels.doc: the negative concord item *žádný*, a proxy for inner negation

levels.name: ppi
levels.label: ppi
levels.doc: the positive polarity item *nějaký*, a proxy for outer negation

features.doc: The contextual evidence of the preceding utterance.

levels.name: negative
levels.label: negative
levels.doc: the context implies that the prejacent is false

levels.name: positive
levels.label: positive
levels.doc: the context implies that the prejacent is true

examples.translation: Didn't Dana plant there any flowers?
examples.context: Dana má na zahradě záhon, který vybudovala před rokem. ('Dana has a garden bed, which she built a year ago.' — neutral, implying neither p nor ¬p)
examples.comment: Mean rating ≈ 3 (Figure 2a). V1 forces the outer reading (FALSUM), which cannot license the NCI žádné: main effect of INDEFINITE in V1, z = −15.674, p < .001. Printed unmarked in (13) as an experimental item; the judgment records the printed mark, the rating is in this comment.

examples.translation: Didn't Dana plant there some flowers?
examples.context: Dana má na zahradě záhon, který vybudovala před rokem. ('Dana has a garden bed, which she built a year ago.' — neutral, implying neither p nor ¬p)
examples.comment: Mean rating ≈ 5, highest in neutral context (Figure 2a; CONTEXT within PPI z = −3.522, p < .001). FALSUM allows the PPI nějaké in its scope.

examples.translation: Dana didn't plant there any flowers?
examples.context: Dana má na zahradě záhon, kam zasadila zeleninu. ('Dana has a garden bed, where she planted vegetables.' — negative, implying ¬p)
examples.comment: Mean rating ≈ 5 in negative context (Figure 2b). The inner default reading licenses the NCI; nonV1 PQs need negative evidential bias (main effect of CONTEXT, z = 8.674, p < 0.01).

examples.translation: Dana didn't plant there some flowers?
examples.context: Dana má na zahradě záhon, kam zasadila zeleninu. ('Dana has a garden bed, where she planted vegetables.' — negative, implying ¬p)
examples.comment: Mean rating ≈ 4 in negative context (Figure 2b). The PPI needs the outer reading, available in nonV1 but dispreferred: main effect of INDEFINITE, z = 6.208, p < 0.01, NCI over PPI. Printed unmarked in (13) as an experimental item; the judgment records the printed mark, the rating is in this comment.

examples.context: Eva se zúčastnila lingvistické olympiády, kde skončila jako první. ('Eva participated in a linguistic olympiad, where she won the first place.' — positive evidence for p)
examples.comment: Median 6, vs 5 for the analogous neutral-context condition (§5.3): Czech FALSUM is compatible even with positive evidential bias, unlike English high negation.

examples.translation: Is Karel going to Brno, by any chance?
Is Karel going to Brno, by any chance?

examples.primaryText: Nezarezervoval si Mikuláš náhodou nějaké sedadlo?
examples.context: Mikuláš cestoval vlakem, který jel do Košic. ('Mikuláš was on the train which went to Košice.' — neutral)
examples.comment: Mean rating ≈ 4.8 in both contexts (Figure 3): náhodou, like its licensor FALSUM, is insensitive to contextual evidence.

examples.primaryText: Nezarezervoval si Mikuláš náhodou žádné sedadlo?
examples.context: Mikuláš cestoval vlakem, který jel do Košic. ('Mikuláš was on the train which went to Košice.' — neutral)
examples.comment: Mean rating ≈ 2.3 neutral / ≈ 3.0 negative (Figure 3). náhodou requires FALSUM, which cannot license the NCI: main effect of INDEFINITE, z = −12.845, p < .001. Printed unmarked in (17) as an experimental item; the judgment records the printed mark, the rating is in this comment.

examples.primaryText: A Petr si náhodou nekoupil nějakou knihu?
examples.translation: And as for Petr, did he buy a book, too, by any chance?
examples.context: Hanka si koupila knihu. ('Hanka bought a book.')
examples.comment: náhodou in a nonV1 PQ: needs a contrastive topic (Petr) and contrastive focus on the negated verb.

examples.primaryText: A Petr si náhodou nekoupil žádnou knihu?
examples.translation: And as for Petr, did he buy a book, too, by any chance?
examples.context: Hanka si koupila knihu. ('Hanka bought a book.')
